name: T02
source:
theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: private-gemini
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hDuDv hdisc
  have h_eq : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M =
      (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) ^ 2 + (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2) * M ^ 2 := by
    rw [T02 m N M]
    grind
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (2 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * N - m.S * M) ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg _
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2 := by omega
  have h3 : 0 ≤ M ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg _
  have h4 : 0 ≤ (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ - m.S ^ 2) * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg h2 h3
  have h5 : 0 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.modeDet N M := by
    rw [h_eq]
    omega
  have h4A : 0 < 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) := by omega
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hneg
  have hlt : m.modeDet N M < 0 := by omega
  have hprod := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hlt h4A
  rw [Int.mul_comm (m.modeDet N M)] at hprod
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M
